task_definition.instruction_en: In a fixed robotic workspace, generate a rigid, physically consistent embodied robotic arm. The arm maintains high stability with no deformation and enters the frame to Using your left arm, lift the black mug, rotate it, place it down, then your right arm to hang it onto the angled rack with long and short rods.
task_definition.instruction_zh: 在固定的机器人工作空间中，生成刚性的、物理一致的具体机器人手臂。手臂保持高度稳定性，不变形，进入框架用左臂提起黑色杯子，旋转它，放下它，然后用右臂将其挂在带有长短杆的斜架上。
